description: Grey all-rounder that passes for most mayflies. Dad's box has more of these than anything else.
Tan elk-hair wing that rides high in fast, broken water. Caddis flutter off the riffle at dusk.
Peacock and red-banded attractor with white wings. Matches nothing, and brook trout love it anyway.
Pale yellow mayfly with light dun wings. On summer mornings the riffles are thick with the real thing.
